lines.text: Seventeen-year-old Joseph brings a bad report about his brothers, and Israel makes him a robe of many colors.
Joseph dreams his brothers' sheaves bow to his, and then the sun, moon, and eleven stars bow to him.
Joseph is sent from the Valley of Hebron to Shechem, and a man tells him his brothers went to Bethel.
The brothers throw Joseph into an empty pit, then sell him to the Ishmaelites for thirty pieces of silver.
The brothers dip Joseph's robe in goat's blood, and Jacob tears his clothes and mourns for his son many days.
